reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the cited § 12.3 supports it.

The rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding Customer, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made 'no ... no-hire commitment' and preserves freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment — i.e., at or above the preferred position, so no edit is warranted.
'Missing' is not the correct classification here: for this rule the absence of the covenant is the desired outcome, not a gap to be filled.

The two failed deterministic checks (duration cap, carve-out regex) are phrasing artefacts — with no restricted period or prohibition in the document there is nothing to cap or carve out; satisfying them literally would require inserting a new restriction on our own client.

Non-double-flagging is handled correctly: the § 12.4 24-month post-term non-compete is an exclusivity/competition restriction routed to the restrictive-covenant rule rather than re-flagged as a personnel non-solicit.
